title: Interactive 3D Reconstruction
description:
Silhouette-based 3D reconstruction by level-set evolution, with user strokes (inside / outside) that steer the result. Runs natively or in the browser through Pyodide.

This is a Python port of the MATLAB code (3d-reconstruction-ui-matlab) behind the paper: B. Islam, J. Liu, A. Yezzi and R. Sandhu, "An Interactive Control Approach to 3D Shape Reconstruction," 2020 American Control Conference (ACC), IEEE, 2020, pp. 5096-5101, doi: 10.23919/ACC45564.2020.9147728.

If you use this software, please cite both this record and the paper.
